subject: DONE bridge batch capacity (gated, default unchanged) + frontend 3-liner request; HEAVY TAKE gates running
body: Bridge (on top of your step 10, your functions untouched): N2MB_BATCH_CAPACITY 128 (array bound), N2MB_BATCH_MAX 32 stays the default runtime cap; unsigned n2mb_batch_capacity(b,cap) (0 = query) / env NORD2_METAL_BATCH_MAX=2..128 at open; batch_prefix_fits stops at the cap, the 32 handles, and a summed geometry budget N2MB_BATCH_GEOMETRY = 32*TEGU_GENERIC_DRAW_GEOMETRY_BUDGET (today's proven 2 MiB-heap worst case). A request longer than the cap now submits its prefix (n2mb_batch_last_count) instead of BAD; > capacity is BAD. Tests: default cap prefix, cap 100 -> chain 101, 40 x 48 KiB draws -> 32, fake chain bound = capacity+1. FRONTEND REQUEST (compositor_submit.inc, yours): draws[N2MB_BATCH_CAPACITY]; before the run loop 'unsigned cap_=n2mb_batch_capacity(d->connection,0);if(cap_<2||cap_>N2MB_BATCH_CAPACITY)cap_=N2MB_BATCH_MAX;' and use cap_ in 'while(run<cap_...' and 'if(run==cap_)reason=TEGU_BREAK_MAX_DRAWS'. Verified in a shadow build with my census: tile-fetch + cap 128 -> FS jobs 1/1/1/1/2/1 (tick/small/medium/large/ca200/blur); preframe on: all 7 FS LOAD jobs INTERSECT, no preload job. Heap use per chain beyond 32 draws is unmodelled on host -> keep default 32 until a device A/B (NORD2_METAL_BATCH_MAX=128, watch NORD2_METAL_TRACE heap-used). Hashes: see next post with gates.
